rationale: Class 1 X04 check of the flagged basis_spread cells. The raw schedule rows for the two flagged Wine.com positions show Reference Rate and Spread as S + 12.00 % PIK, so the stored basis_spread value 12.0 is source-supported. The flag appears to come from treating these rows as fixed-coupon instruments, but the source describes a reference-rate-plus-spread term.
